name: 03 Daily advisor alerts (missed deadlines, syllabus behind)

parameters.query:
-- Students with 3+ tasks overdue in the last 7 days, or whose last exam is 10+ points under target.
-- Same rules as the 'Needs attention' list on the student dashboard.
WITH overdue AS (
  SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks
  WHERE due_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 AND CURRENT_DATE - 1 AND completed_on IS NULL
  GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT s.student_id, s.display_name, o.n AS overdue_tasks, s.advisor_clickup_list_id
FROM overdue o JOIN students s USING (student_id);
